diagnostics.message: :module.csi: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.csi declares `depends_on = [module.eks]`, but its addon configuration already references module.eks attributes (`eks_name = module.eks.cluster.name` and `oidc = module.eks.oidc`), so Terraform already infers a dependency on module.eks from those attribute references. The explicit depends_on duplicates that already-established dependency.
